title: The Vell Ask
text: Runners from the Vell camp stand at the edge of our lights. The cold months are coming and their stores are thin. They ask for food.

choices.label: Give them 80 biomass
choices.reply: The runners load the sacks onto their backs and go without a word. The song-keeper sends one back to bow.

choices.label: We can't spare it
choices.reply: They hear it and leave. The fire at their camp burns lower that night.

choices.label: Trade food for their songs
choices.reply: 40 biomass for an evening of star-songs, recorded. The translators work all night.
